scope: All reachable four-string-option, exactly-one-matching-answer MCQs across all 100 registered pathways. Shared variants counted once using subject, ID, stem, answer, unordered options and explanation. Different Foundation/Higher content variants count separately. Lab investigation dropdowns and written tests are not single-answer four-option MCQs.
method: Offline deterministic SHA-256 seed search (seed 363), stored full-content-key option orders. Preserve distractor relative order, insert correct answer at selected position. questionPool applies validated cloned arrays after tier filtering. No runtime randomness, no raw curriculum/audit content edits.
